plugins.name: agent-discipline
plugins.description: Not how to build things, but how not to ship something broken while you build them. Five skills: diagnose-first, output-contracts, verify-in-the-target-environment, handoff-script-hygiene, independent-verifier. Each was written after an incident and carries a Fisher exact p-value against a control arm; five more were written and removed because the same measurement found no effect.
